method: Chronological contact sheets of full scene, face, hands, and legs sampled through all 90 frames
petals: PASS: bright petals visibly descend and cross the scene
hair: PASS_SUBTLE: loose strands shift slightly while head and framing remain stable
hands: PASS_SUBTLE: finger and wrist positions vary slightly, with umbrella grip largely maintained
leg: PASS_SUBTLE: forward ankle and foot change position slightly, returning close to initial crossed pose
overall: PASS_TEST_ONLY: all requested motion types are visible, but hand and leg changes are deliberately small
limitations: Visual qualitative review; no quantitative joint-tracking or production-quality acceptance claim
